longDescription:
minexpert is a program used to visualize and mine MS^n mass spectral data, like mass spectra.

The program has the following features::

  • Open any number of mzML-formatted mass spec data files;
  • The program computes the TIC chromatogram and the mz=ft(dt) color map if data are for an ion mobility mass spectrometry experiment;
  • Any number of integrations (combinations) can be performed in any direction;
  • Navigation through the data is intuitive, flexible yet powerful;
  • Isotopic cluster calculations that can be configured to the finest detail.
  • The vast majority of the features of mineXpert2 can be driven by JavaScript'ing.
